blind_target.title: Avoiding overhead aversion in charity
blind_target.evidence_quote: Hypothesis 7, which found that participants were biased towards a charity where overhead is paid for by another donor even when cost-effectiveness is kept constant, acts as a conceptual replication of Gneezy et al . [ 16 ].
blind_target.outcome_quote: Hypothesis 7, which found that participants were biased towards a charity where overhead is paid for by another donor even when cost-effectiveness is kept constant, acts as a conceptual replication of Gneezy et al . [ 16 ]. In contrast to the between-subject design that they used in their study, our extension shows that this effect occurs in a within-subject context as well.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly confirm the replicated finding; the overall verdict governs the Baron and Szymanska target.
